decision.observation: 9:50 pm, Sat. 6; the bobber rests in the pond at ~(0.79,0.72) with the line from the rod; no dip or 'HIT!' cue yet. The clock hasn't advanced with the waits.
decision.hypothesis: The bite may take longer; continuing short waits should eventually produce a dip cue to press C, though with energy exhausted and only ~4 hours left, the 2 am pass-out will end the day regardless.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at the bobber dip; if the bar minigame opens, hold/release LMB to keep the green bar on the fish. Catches: Sunfish (day 5), Joja Cola x2 (day 6).
